Overview

Hubli is a city in Karnataka with a population of 950,000. A major commercial and industrial center in North Karnataka, known for its cotton and textile industries. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
